title: Roasted Syrian Chicken Shawarma
description: A flavorful and spicy Middle Eastern dish featuring roasted chicken, wrapped in warm pita bread with tangy yogurt sauce.
instructions: In a small bowl, mix together Syrian spice blend, lemon juice, garlic, salt, and pepper.
Rub the spice mixture evenly over the chicken breast, making sure to coat all surfaces.
Place the chicken on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper and bake for 25-30 minutes or until cooked through.
Warm the pita bread by wrapping it in foil and heating it in the oven for a few minutes.
To assemble the shawarma, slice the roasted chicken into thin strips and place it on a warmed pita bread.
Top the chicken with yogurt sauce, diced cucumber, and chopped parsley.
Serve immediately with baked pita chips on the side.
